run.rulesInOwnWords: 1) Charge: add this cycle's charge row to each crucible; no capacity limit yet. 2) Overflow: go 1 to 6 in order; if melt > working volume, cap it at working volume and push the excess into the next crucible (already counted when that crucible is handled); excess from crucible 6 goes to slag. 3) State check on post-overflow melt: BASE becomes SUPERHEATED if melt >= upper mark; SUPERHEATED becomes BASE if melt <= lower mark; otherwise unchanged (hysteresis). Log each change. 4) Draw-off: using the melt after Step 2/3 and the new state, compute every amount first (BASE: floor(melt/4); SUPERHEATED: floor(melt/2)), then apply all at once. Each crucible loses its own amount. BASE draw-off goes to slag. SUPERHEATED draw-off goes back to the previous crucible (crucible 1's goes to slag). No capacity limit here; any excess waits until the next cycle's Step 2. 5) Emergency tap: if the total melt across all six is strictly greater than 38, halve every crucible (round down), send the removed melt to slag, and log the cycle. Repeat for cycles 1 to 5. Balance: starting melt + all charges = end melt + slag.
